prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
ai_overview_text:
The best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice blend depth psychology (such as Carl Jung's framework) with somatic or meditative integration: YouTube·Jordan Thornton - Inner Work +1
Focus: Beginner-friendly introduction covering inner reflection, heart chakra self-care, identifying triggers, projection, and communicating with the shadow self.
Format: 2-hour video course with practical exercises, editable digital journaling prompts, and guided meditations. Udemy
Focus: A deep dive into shadow origins, epigenetic/archetypal shadow inheritance, triggers, and compassion, paired with a 98-page companion workbook.
Format: Self-paced video modules with daily integration and dream interpretation exercises. Udemy
Focus: Offers structured digital programs (Living from a Place of Surrender, Embracing the Unknown, and various psychology-to-spirituality bridges) taught by renowned spiritual teachers and psychotherapists like Tara Brach, Eckhart Tolle, and Pema Chödrön.
Format: Flexible, self-paced multi-media modules focusing on emotional integration and mindfulness. Sounds True +1
Focus: A 12-week self-paced course by a psychotherapist designed to uncover, process, and integrate unconscious limiting beliefs and repressed self-aspects.
Format: Sequential weekly audio, introspective prompts, and mindfulness exercises (note: best paired with a support system as it covers intense emotional ground).
Focus: Gentle, 10-day introductory course utilizing somatic body awareness, inner child healing, and daily integration rituals.
Format: Short daily audio guides (about 10 minutes per day). Insight Timer
